finding: Slovak firms face persistent margin compression as input costs dwarf selling prices
bullets: Slovak firms expected production input prices to rise by 7.33% (n=224) over the next 12 months, 1.98 pp above the EA's 5.35%, despite easing 0.98 pp from wave 38's 8.31%.
Average selling price expectations stood at 3.75% (n=222) in Slovakia — above the EA's 3.27% — leaving a 3.58 pp gap between anticipated cost increases and price pass-through capacity.
Slovak firms anticipated average wage growth of 4.12% (n=233), 1.52 pp above the EA's 2.60%, adding further pressure on operating margins alongside elevated input cost expectations.
chart_subtitle: Slovak input price expectations at 7.33%, well above EA's 5.35%.
